banner: MOCK ADAPTER - not a real model evaluation

executive_summary.what_was_tested: yolov8n v1 (pt, task detect) evaluated with the mock adapter on synthetic dataset 'harbor reef sweep' (24 frames, 4 classes) at conf 0.25, NMS IoU 0.7, imgsz 640.
executive_summary.overall: MOCK ADAPTER - not a real model evaluation. At conf=0.25 and IoU 0.5 the model reached precision 0.769, recall 0.484 and F1 0.594 over 62 ground-truth objects in 24 frames. mAP@50 is 0.481 and mAP@50:95 is 0.314.

key_findings.text: MOCK ADAPTER - not a real model evaluation: detections were simulated from ground truth.
Overall recall 0.484 and precision 0.769 (TP=30, FP=9, FN=32).
Largest condition effect: current_dir_deg (recall 0.800 in 'S' versus 0.000 in 'NW').
Most frequent confusion: PERSON predicted as MINE (1 time).

performance_breakdown.narrative: At conf=0.25 and IoU 0.5 the model reached precision 0.769, recall 0.484 and F1 0.594 over 62 ground-truth objects in 24 frames. mAP@50 is 0.481 and mAP@50:95 is 0.314. Per class: SHIPWRECK: P=1.000, R=0.500, AP50=0.505 (support 16); MINE: P=0.667, R=0.571, AP50=0.574 (support 14); DEBRIS: P=0.667, R=0.400, AP50=0.396 (support 15); PERSON: P=0.800, R=0.471, AP50=0.449 (support 17).

environmental_sensitivity.narrative: Recall varies across condition buckets with at least 5 objects: current_dir_deg: recall 0.800 ('S', n_gt=5) to 0.000 ('NW', n_gt=6); current_speed_mps: recall 0.833 ('slack', n_gt=12) to 0.214 ('moderate', n_gt=14), slope -0.555 recall per unit; depth_m: recall 0.727 ('20-50m', n_gt=11) to 0.222 ('5-10m', n_gt=9), slope 0.010 recall per unit; distance_m: recall 0.615 ('1-2m', n_gt=13) to 0.167 ('<1m', n_gt=6). These are associations in synthetic data, not proven causes.

Model: latency_ms = GFLOPs_at_imgsz / effective_GFLOPs * 1000 + overhead_ms; GFLOPs scale with (imgsz/ref)^2.
No accelerator (Coral / Hailo) assumed. Batch size 1. Active cooling assumed.

next_experiment.rationale: current_dir_deg shows the largest recall gap (0.800 versus 0.000); repeat it with more frames and the suggested inference settings to confirm the effect.

config_suggestions.reason: The confidence sweep peaks at F1=0.606 at conf=0.32; the run used conf=0.25 with F1=0.594.
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: F1 on this synthetic dataset rises from 0.594 to 0.606 at the same IoU 0.5 matching.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: Lower thresholds raise recall and false positives; higher thresholds do the opposite. Tuned on one dataset; re-check on held-out conditions.
config_suggestions.rationale: The confidence sweep peaks at F1=0.606 at conf=0.32; the run used conf=0.25 with F1=0.594.

config_suggestions.reason: Recall in 'dim' lighting is 0.350 versus 0.682 in 'bright' (gap 0.332).
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Wider brightness augmentation exposes the model to darker scenes during training.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: Too much brightness jitter can reduce accuracy in well-lit scenes.
config_suggestions.rationale: Recall in 'dim' lighting is 0.350 versus 0.682 in 'bright' (gap 0.332).

config_suggestions.reason: Detection is strongest in the 'bright' lighting bucket.
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Operating with more illumination should move conditions toward the best-performing bucket.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: More light increases backscatter in turbid water; validate jointly with turbidity.
config_suggestions.rationale: Detection is strongest in the 'bright' lighting bucket.

config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Stronger saturation augmentation approximates the colour loss of turbid water.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: Does not model scattering or haze; pair with a haze augmentation.

config_suggestions.suggested: add haze / low-contrast augmentation (for example albumentations RandomFog or a custom backscatter model) with p=0.2
config_suggestions.reason: Ultralytics hyperparameters cannot express turbidity directly.
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Training data closer to turbid test conditions.
config_suggestions.rationale: Ultralytics hyperparameters cannot express turbidity directly.

config_suggestions.reason: Recall is 0.214 in 'moderate' current versus 0.833 in 'slack'; strong current induces vehicle roll and pitch.
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Rotation augmentation covers tilted camera views.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: The link between current and camera tilt is an assumption; verify with attitude logs.
config_suggestions.rationale: Recall is 0.214 in 'moderate' current versus 0.833 in 'slack'; strong current induces vehicle roll and pitch.

config_suggestions.reason: Recall for 'partial' occlusion is 0.359 (n_gt=39) versus 0.800 for 'none'.
config_suggestions.expected_benefit: Blended training images expose partially visible objects.
config_suggestions.tradeoffs: Mixup can slow convergence; keep it small.
config_suggestions.rationale: Recall for 'partial' occlusion is 0.359 (n_gt=39) versus 0.800 for 'none'.

disclaimers: MOCK ADAPTER - not a real model evaluation
Results come from synthetic imagery rendered by the GANTRYLAB digital twin; real-world performance may differ.
Slices with fewer than 5 ground-truth objects are excluded from best / worst rankings.
Condition effects are associations observed in this dataset, not proven causes.
Estimated hardware figures come from a labelled throughput model and are not measurements.
Configuration suggestions are hypotheses to test. No weights were changed and no improvement is claimed.
